sources: antigravity.google/docs (skills, subagents, rules, workflows, mcp, permissions, plugins), researched 2026-11-17. Not run live by FORGE.

entryCommand.native: the `/forge` skill in the App and CLI; in the IDE, the legacy `/forge` workflow, because skills are not documented as slash-invocable there

requestArguments.fallback: treat the message that invoked `/forge` as the request

skillDir.fallback: the folder of the forge SKILL.md you loaded: `.agents/skills/forge/` in the workspace, else `~/.gemini/config/skills/forge/`

subagents.native: `invoke_subagent` with the agent's name (App and CLI). The IDE does not document custom subagents, so use Mode B there

parallelSubagents.native: several `invoke_subagent` calls in one step (App and CLI)

foregroundWait.fallback: wait for every subagent's result and every long command before ending the turn; never end it with work pending

continueSubagent.fallback: launch a fresh verifier with its previous report and only the delta

perCallModel.native: agent frontmatter accepts `model: inherit | flash | pro`, not a model per delegation
perCallModel.fallback: every agent runs on the session model; record a model escalation as unavailable in the report

toolRestriction.fallback: `tools` is omitted because tool names differ and an unknown one can hang the agent; read-only roles follow their instructions, and the host's permission rules still apply

gitGuardHook.fallback: the no-commit rules are instructions only; recommend a host deny rule such as `command(regex:git (commit|push|merge|rebase))` (docs/security.md)

preApprovedScripts.fallback: the host's command rules decide; if prompts slow the run, ask the user to allow `node <FORGE_HOME>/scripts/*`

userQuestion.native: ask in chat and wait for the reply

deferredTools.fallback: call MCP tools directly by name

browserTools.native: the built-in browser subagent, plus MCP servers from `~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json` or `.agents/mcp_config.json`

backgroundCommands.fallback: run long suites in the foreground

requiredConfig: Install with `scripts/install.sh --target antigravity` (or `install.ps1 -Target antigravity`) into `~/.gemini/config/` or `<project>/.agents/`.
Optional, for Playwright and DevTools: MCP servers in `mcp_config.json` (docs/installation.md).
limitations: Never exercised live by FORGE: the formats are checked against the documentation only (docs/testing.md has the manual procedure).
No enforced tool allow-lists, git guard or pre-approved scripts: the rules are instructions, backed by the host's own permission system.
Every agent inherits the session model, so the standard/strong split and model escalation do not apply.
The IDE does not document custom subagents or skill slash commands: FORGE uses Mode B and the legacy workflow there.
